title: Diagnosis and Management of Barrett's Esophagus: An Updated ACG Guideline

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Diagnosis and Management of Barrett's Esophagus: An Updated ACG Guideline》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Barrett's esophagus (BE) is a common condition associated with chronic gastroesophageal reflux disease.

evidence.text: Barrett's esophagus (BE) is a common condition associated with chronic gastroesophageal reflux disease.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Diagnosis and Management of Barrett's Esophagus: An Updated ACG Guideline》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】These revised guidelines implement Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation methodology to propose recommendations for the definition and diagnosis of BE, screening for BE and esophageal adenocarcinoma, surveillance of patients with known BE, and the medical and endoscopic treatment of BE and its associated early neoplasia.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】We recommend endoscopic eradication therapy for patients with BE and high-grade dysplasia and those with BE and low-grade dysplasia.

evidence.text: These revised guidelines implement Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation methodology to propose recommendations for the definition and diagnosis of BE, screening for BE and esophageal adenocarcinoma, surveillance of patients with known BE, and the medical and endoscopic treatment of BE and its associated early neoplasia.
We recommend endoscopic eradication therapy for patients with BE and high-grade dysplasia and those with BE and low-grade dysplasia.
